facts.value: MyPath2ASU® is ASU's transfer admission guarantee, designed to simplify your journey to a bachelor's degree.

facts.value: MyPath2ASU® creates personalized, course-by-course transfer maps for any regionally accredited community college or four-year institution.

facts.value: Simply enter your chosen major and transfer school, and MyPath2ASU® will identify the courses at your current institution that directly apply to your ASU major and satisfy ASU transfer requirements.

facts.value: This personalized map helps you save time and money and minimize credit loss as you prepare to transfer to ASU.
